source.excerpt: Shared as an answer-engine optimisation program rather than a spot check.

body:
## What it does

Answer-engine and generative-engine optimisation run as ongoing work rather than a one-off check of what a chatbot says about you today. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer. The framing is the useful part: what an answer engine says about you drifts, so a single audit tells you about a day rather than a position.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @mathiasnoyez shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
